Legal Information

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2026 | Effective for Ojaswi Foods / Ojaswi Premium Spices

1. Introduction & Scope

Ojaswi Foods ("we", "us", or "our"), operating the brand Ojaswi Premium from 52/2, Malegaon - 423203, Nashik, Maharashtra, India (FSSAI Lic. 3025120612245599988), respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act of India.

2. Information We Collect

To fulfill your authentic spice orders and provide customer support, we collect:

  • Customer Contact Details: Full Name, 10-digit Indian Mobile Number, and Email Address.
  • Delivery Address: House/Flat number, Area/Street, City, District, State, and 6-digit Indian PIN Code.
  • Order & Transaction Details: Products purchased, quantities, invoice amounts, payment method (COD or Online Payment status).
  • Authentication Records: Encrypted one-time password (OTP) verification records and secure session cookies.

3. Purpose of Processing

We use your personal data strictly for:

  • Processing, packing, and dispatching spice parcels from our Malegaon facility.
  • Sending transactional order receipts, shipment notifications, and OTP codes via SMS, WhatsApp, and Email.
  • Fulfilling statutory tax and food safety regulatory requirements under FSSAI.

4. Payment & Financial Security

We do not store credit card numbers, CVVs, or UPI PINs on our servers. Online payments are processed directly by certified RBI-authorized payment aggregators (e.g. Razorpay) using 256-bit SSL encryption.
